subject: Medford High School Renovation Statement of Interest
overview: The Council approved a Statement of Interest for Medford High School renovation through the state school building authority and advanced a modernized snow removal ordinance. Members also debated sidewalk and stump removal funding while confirming new members to the Election Commission.

items.title: Trash and Recycling Education Plan
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the administration develop an education program to inform constituents about recycling contamination rules to reduce future contract costs.

items.title: MSBA Statement of Interest for Medford High School
items.summary: Approved a Statement of Interest to the Massachusetts School Building Authority core program to address HVAC, energy, and ADA deficiencies at the high school. Officials noted the school is 50 years old and requires significant modernization to prevent student outflow to other districts.

items.title: Election Commission Appointments
items.summary: Confirmed the appointments of Mark Crowley, Tony Nardella, and Henry Miller, while the appointment of Joyce Paul was not approved.

items.title: Snow and Ice Removal Ordinance Amendment
items.summary: Approved the first reading of an ordinance requiring residents and owners to clear a 36-inch path on sidewalks within eight hours of snow cessation. A secondary motion was approved requesting additional funding for code enforcement officers to manage the new regulations.

items.title: Snow Removal Policy Recommendations
items.summary: Approved recommendations for the administration to improve plowing practices, expand the paid shoveler program, and create exemptions for elderly or disabled residents.

items.title: Nightlife and Business District Vitality
items.summary: Referred a resolution to explore ordinance and licensing changes to encourage nightlife, dining, and recreation in Medford's business districts to the Zoning, Planning, and Development subcommittee.

items.title: Condo Conversion Ordinance Proposal
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Housing subcommittee to discuss a proposed ordinance aimed at protecting tenants when large rental buildings are converted to condominiums.

items.title: City Council Rules Update
items.summary: Approved revised council rules that update parliamentary language, streamline the order of business, and codify the public participation process. Discussion on changing meeting frequency from weekly to bi-weekly was deferred to a future meeting.

items.title: Drone and Unmanned Aircraft Regulation
items.summary: Requested the city solicitor draft an ordinance to regulate personal drone use to address resident concerns regarding privacy and quality of life.

items.title: Sidewalk and Stump Removal Loan Orders
items.summary: Approved the first readings of loan orders for $1,000,000 in sidewalk bonds and $250,000 for stump removal. Some councilors expressed preference for creating an internal city crew for sidewalk repair rather than relying on external contractors.

items.title: Condolences for John Stirella
items.summary: Passed a resolution of condolence for John Stirella, a World War II veteran and longtime meeting participant known for his regular contributions to budget discussions.
